tasks.short: Build a coalition of organisations and public figures, secure support, and coordinate campaign commitments.

steps.what: Define campaign goals, partner criteria, and acceptable commitments.
Research potential partners and document their interests, relevance, and existing relationships.

loop.input: Approved contact records and public website material for a bounded candidate list.
loop.output: Partner profiles with source references and explicit unknowns.
loop.check: Validate source references and contact identifiers; a coordinator checks relevance and unsupported claims.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair per profile; missing evidence goes to the coordinator.
loop.why_not_simpler: Partner interests appear in free text with inconsistent formats.

steps.what: Select a balanced shortlist and agree relationship owners.
Draft tailored invitations explaining the shared purpose and proposed contribution.

loop.input: Coalition brief, selected partner profile, and approved invitation template.
loop.output: Invitation draft with a specific proposed contribution.
loop.check: Check names, factual claims, commitments, and alignment with the approved brief.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision per invitation; unresolved issues require manual editing.
loop.why_not_simpler: A useful invitation connects each partner's stated interests to the campaign.

steps.what: Review invitations, confirm the contact route, and send.
Discuss interests, resolve concerns, and negotiate cooperation and commitments.
Record agreed commitments, owners, deadlines, and unresolved questions.

loop.output: Proposed commitment records with owners, dates, and agreement status.
loop.check: Validate dates and owners; the relationship owner confirms what was actually agreed.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair per meeting; ambiguous commitments remain unconfirmed.
loop.why_not_simpler: Meeting notes mix proposals, conditions, and actual agreements.

steps.what: Chase updates, coordinate joint actions, and escalate stalled commitments.

tasks.design: Configure partner records in the {CRM} and commitment tracking in the {PROJECT}, linked by stable partner identifiers. Bounded loops prepare sourced profiles, invitation drafts, and proposed commitment records; people select partners, negotiate, and approve external messages. The {WORKFLOW} prepares reminders and routes unresolved commitments to relationship owners.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relationship context sits across personal correspondence, public material, and meeting notes. Existing records can track contacts but cannot decide whom to trust or what support is credible.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing record and reminder features cover coordination. AI-assisted coding can reduce the effort of linking records and adding bounded extraction and drafting.
tasks.still_hard: Trust, conflicting interests, reputational fit, and reciprocal commitments remain personal work. Contact data requires GDPR controls; outreach must follow applicable ePrivacy and national rules.
tasks.human_edge: People earn trust, recognise unspoken objections, and negotiate commitments that partners will honour.

ambition.what: Small community organisations previously excluded by the effort of coordinating many modest contributions.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends less time reconstructing commitments and more time developing relationships with smaller partners. Spending, endorsement, and contractual decision rights stay unchanged.

reach.task: Assess reputational fit before approaching a public figure.
reach.learn: Stakeholder mapping, reputation checks, and endorsement boundaries.

reach.task: Turn partner commitments into a joint campaign activation.
reach.learn: Dependencies, accessibility needs, and partner delivery checkpoints.

evidence.claim: Contact records, task ownership, and scheduled reminders can support coalition administration using existing software.
HubSpot lists campaign-plan and branded-content drafting, supporting the preparation component.
GDPR Article 21 requires direct marketing processing to stop following an objection.
ePrivacy regulates unsolicited marketing communications; the permitted contact route needs checking.

assumptions: The company maintains usable contact records and a shared campaign brief.
Representation criteria concern relevant perspectives and organisation types; the system does not infer sensitive personal traits.
Relationship owners negotiate within existing authority and refer binding commitments through existing approvals.
Build ranges are estimates for a limited pilot using existing systems, not measured productivity claims.
Access estimates include privacy review and any consultation required under national rules; formal consultation may extend elapsed time.
unknowns: Whether relationship owners consistently record meetings and commitments.
Which contact routes and lawful bases apply to the intended partners.
Whether existing systems expose suitable connectors or exports.
Which commitments require legal, budget, or executive approval.
Whether national employee consultation requirements apply to the proposed implementation.
research_questions: Can coordinators distinguish agreed commitments from proposals reliably using the available notes?
Which partner selection criteria broaden participation without producing unsuitable approaches?
Do reminder drafts reduce coordination work without weakening personal relationships?
new_work: Check profile sources and correct stale contact information.
Review invitation drafts and approve external reminders.
Confirm extracted commitments and resolve ambiguous agreement status.
Maintain templates, access permissions, retention rules, and failed synchronisations.

tasks.short: Direct marketing-led product research and coordinate development priorities, trials, and decisions with technical teams.

steps.what: Collect customer feedback and campaign response data relevant to product opportunities.
Write a research brief linking customer needs to proposed product hypotheses.

loop.input: Customer insight pack, research notes, product strategy, and approved brief template.
loop.output: Draft research brief with sourced observations, hypotheses, and evidence gaps.
loop.check: Trace observations to sources; validate copied figures; the manager checks hypotheses and research purpose.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision per brief; conflicting evidence is flagged for manual resolution.
loop.why_not_simpler: Customer needs and research notes contain free text requiring synthesis.

steps.what: Discuss feasibility, technical constraints, research methods, and delivery options.
Approve trial priorities, scope, funding, and success criteria.
Translate approved scope into milestones, responsibilities, dependencies, and review dates.
Lead progress reviews, resolve dependencies, and negotiate changes with delivery teams.
Assemble trial findings, limitations, and comparisons against agreed success criteria.

loop.input: Validated trial results, research notes, success criteria, and reporting template.
loop.output: Draft trial findings separating measured results, qualitative observations, and limitations.
loop.check: Calculate comparisons deterministically; trace narrative claims; the analyst verifies interpretation and uncertainty.
loop.stop: One draft and one repair per report; missing or inconsistent results block completion.
loop.why_not_simpler: Qualitative observations need concise synthesis alongside structured results.

steps.what: Agree the marketing recommendation to continue, revise, or stop the trial.
Compile and circulate routine milestone, issue, and decision status.

tasks.design: Configure recurring insight exports from the {CRM}, {ADS}, and {MARKETING_AUTOMATION}, and trial templates and status notifications in the {PROJECT}. Bounded loops draft research briefs and findings in the {DOCS}, using deterministic calculations and source references. People retain feasibility assessment, funding approval, delivery negotiation, and product recommendations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Customer evidence, technical constraints, and project decisions live in separate records. Templates can organise delivery, but research synthesis and competing priorities still require judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing reporting and project automation cover routine collection and coordination. AI-assisted coding can make small integrations cheaper, while bounded drafting handles mixed research notes.
tasks.still_hard: Sound research design, uncertain demand, technical feasibility, and resource conflicts remain difficult. Sensitive research data needs GDPR controls; employee-facing research or monitoring may require consultation under national rules.
tasks.human_edge: The manager frames useful questions, challenges weak evidence, and reconciles commercial goals with technical limits.

ambition.what: A fortnightly decision on whether to continue, revise, or stop a marketing-led product trial.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends less time assembling briefs and status reports and more time comparing trial evidence with development teams. Recommendations can become more frequent; funding and technical release decision rights stay unchanged.

reach.task: Specify a trial capable of testing a product hypothesis.
reach.learn: Sampling, comparison groups, uncertainty, and the limits of campaign response as demand evidence.

reach.task: Translate trial findings into a product positioning recommendation.
reach.learn: Customer value, commercial assumptions, and criteria for changing positioning.

reach.task: Maintain a clear record of trial assumptions and decisions.
reach.learn: Evidence traceability, version control, and separating observations from conclusions.

evidence.claim: Funnel offers channel-data connectors, standardisation, and automated reporting, supporting campaign evidence collection.
Project templates, dependencies, and scheduled status reports can automate routine research coordination.
Bounded drafting can assist research briefs and findings when source checks and expert review remain in place.
Research validity, feasibility decisions, and resource negotiation remain expert responsibilities in this design.

assumptions: The role coordinates marketing-led research and development with a separate technical lead.
Customer signal collection uses existing fields and reports; substantive interpretation happens in later steps.
Approved trial scopes can use standard fields and project templates.
Routine status reports circulate only approved facts to an authorised internal audience.
Initial work excludes automated participant selection, employee scoring, and technical release decisions.
Build ranges are pilot estimates and include access review and consultation where national rules require it.
EU GDPR and EU AI Act requirements are assessed for the actual data and uses; consultation can extend elapsed time.
unknowns: How much product development authority the advertising manager actually holds.
Whether customer feedback, trial results, and success criteria are recorded consistently.
Whether technical or sector-specific validation requirements apply.
Which systems offer exports, connectors, and suitable access permissions.
Whether participant data or employee monitoring introduces additional consultation requirements.
Which sponsor approves funding changes and decisions following a trial.
research_questions: Can the existing evidence support a useful trial brief without additional primary research?
Which report sections require expert interpretation rather than template assembly?
Does a fortnightly review cadence fit trial duration and technical capacity?
Can reviewers detect omitted limitations and unsupported conclusions reliably?
new_work: Maintain insight mappings, trial templates, and success-criteria fields.
Review brief drafts and verify the interpretation of trial findings.
Resolve incomplete evidence and inconsistent project updates.
Monitor connector failures, access permissions, and research-data retention.
Keep decision records aligned with approved scope and funding.

role.altitude: The role shifts some preparation and coordination time toward partner relationships and evidence-based trial reviews. Existing commercial, technical, and spending approval rights remain in place.
reach: Public relations: assess partner reputation and endorsement implications.
Market research: frame testable hypotheses and interpret uncertain findings.
Marketing management: connect trial evidence to positioning and campaign choices.
Event planning: coordinate joint activations with smaller coalition partners.
skills_to_grow: Structured briefs, commitment records, and decision logs.
Configuring workflows and diagnosing data-quality problems.
role.ambitious_version: Run a recurring partner-backed product trial programme that includes smaller community organisations and produces fortnightly marketing recommendations when evidence is ready.
